_comment: Auto-update and problem reporting are configured here, and nowhere else.
repo:     the GitHub repository to take releases from, as owner/name.
It must be public — the launcher uses no token and no account,
so there is nothing to leak and nothing for a teacher to set up.
Leave it as the placeholder and this copy simply never updates,
which is a perfectly good state for a machine that has no
internet or sits behind a filter that blocks GitHub.
reportTo: OPTIONAL. A URL to POST a problem report to automatically.
Absent by default, and it should stay absent unless your
district has agreed to it. Without it, reports are written to
the reports folder and a pre-filled page opens for the teacher
to read and submit themselves. See tools/report.mjs.
